title: Questioning the Flat Minima Hypothesis
note: Grew out of Muon Operates Beyond the Edge of Stability, a joint work with Niko Čović, Baraq Lipshitz and Stefan Višnjić at ETH Zürich.
description: Validating the Flat Minima Hypothesis for Muon: raw vs adaptive sharpness, and an interactive look at 512 CIFAR-10 runs.
